recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future correction to the current-job indicator should be handled in the US ODH IG/source repository, not in current FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-15014 is Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core OccupationalData. It asked for a way to distinguish current from past OccupationalData.pastOrPresentJob entries when dates are absent; the resolution said to add active/current and completed/historical status semantics.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit mentioning FHIR-15014 or ODHIsCurrentJobExtension was found. PHWG minutes still listed FHIR-15014 as resolved but not applied in February 2022, and the later Jira comment says the change was applied in ODH 1.1 and retained in 1.2 by adding ODHIsCurrentJobExtension to the Past or Present Job profile.
additional_context: Current FHIR core does not build OccupationalData: source/fhir.ini omits it from active resources/profiles and only records `; OccupationalDataforHealth=pending -> Dropped` in the deleted-resource notes. The retained source/occupationaldata files are historical/out-of-build. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout also lacks ODHIsCurrentJob/PastOrPresentJob content, while the published external hl7.fhir.us.odh IG contains the PastOrPresentJob profile and boolean ODHIsCurrentJobExtension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no FHIR core source change because the only live specification surface for the applied decision is the US ODH IG.
